name: computable-systems-engineering
description: Engineer-directed concept, CONOPS and scenario skills plus a source-grounded diagram reference library.

interface.shortDescription: Develop concepts with the engineer in control
interface.longDescription: Three independently invocable engineering drafting skills plus a diagram-generation reference skill/library. Source-linked diagrams retain engineering meaning and report parser, rendering and fidelity checks separately. New engineering-model creation and acceptance remain with the engineer.
defaultPrompt: Use the system-concept and CONOPS skills on the material below. Keep my raw materials out of Git.
Help me develop a system concept.
Help me develop one operational scenario.
Use the diagram reference skill to render this accepted model and show its source and validation limits.
